title: CoChangeResponse
description: The pairs of files changed together; kept apart from the snapshot (it depends on the history).

pairs.description: Sorted by decreasing `commits`, then by paths.

CoChangePair.description: Two files changed in the same commits.

a.description: Repository path of the first file (`a < b`).

b.description: Repository path of the second file.

commits.description: Counted commits that touch both files.

confidence.description: `commits` over the commits of the most changed of the two files.

support.description: `commits` over the counted commits of the period.
